data.name: UNIT-5000
data.detailed_description:
Wake Up Call…

Welcome, Operator.

Your mission briefing is ready:

Universal Neural Integrated Technology, also known as U.N.I.T. It's the most advanced Tactical Combat Drone of our time. Its multi-adaptive system gives you a high variety of weapon customization and an On-The-Go Enhancement right during battle.

Break & Enter
A secret research facility (codename: "Camelot-3") experienced a catastrophic accident during an experiment involving [TOP SECRET]. This incident caused a localized rupture in space-time, opening an uncontrolled portal. Immediately, hostile outer world lifeforms began breaking through. These creatures are highly aggressive and extremely dangerous. They do not communicate through any known means.

Your objective: Stop the alien lifeform invasion by reaching the portal and closing it. Unfortunately, the enemy has already taken over most of the island [REDACTED], where the facility is located. Your UNIT will deploy on its coast as the current safest territory. Destroy everything and anything that stands in your way.

Always Outnumbered, Never Outgunned
You’ll have access to 20 unique weapons. Most of them are experimental prototypes developed under Project [CLASSIFIED]. These weapons were also designed to enhance UNIT’s combat capabilities but have not been fully tested. While basic stats are available, their side effects - especially when combined - remain unknown.

Since each weapon was developed in different parts of the island, currently mostly under enemy control. Therefore, your UNIT will start with a standard-issue loadout approved by the [REDACTED] Department. Use it to secure the experimental weapons scattered across the island.

Invaders Must Die
An intel from the [CLASSIFIED] Division confirms that the enemy forces are led by powerful warlords. These high-priority targets are extremely dangerous and each one can shift between multiple unique forms. If you encounter one, eliminate it immediately. The obtained weapons will help you destroy most obstacles.

Climbatize
The [CLASSIFIED] Anomaly Research Team has detected suspicious energy signatures across the island. Some are caused by the portal. Others suggest the enemy is terraforming parts of the island to suit their needs. This means the terrain is constantly shifting, making all our maps useless. You’ll need to rely on real-time navigation and adapt your tactics on the fly.

Phoenix
Thanks to generous funding from the [CONFIDENTIAL], the UNIT development team can immediately replace your UNIT if it’s destroyed. However, please try to keep your current UNIT intact until you reach a safe zone. Otherwise, all collected materials and data will be lost. Our Support Department is also working on a rescue drone under Project [DELETED] to help you recover some of these resources. Let’s hope it’s ready by the time you deploy.

Colours
To boost UNIT’s appeal under the [OMITTED] government outreach program, the marketing department will provide customization kits for your UNIT. These are purely cosmetic and won’t affect any technical specifications. Check them out in the garage during regrouping, but don’t spend too much time on aesthetics.

Music Reach (1/2/3/4)
Your UNIT is equipped with a cutting-edge radio module, model [RESTRICTED], capable of reaching your UNIT through any anomaly. Unfortunately, for now, it only picks up music vibes. The [CLASSIFIED] Team is working on upgrades, so in the meantime, enjoy a curated playlist from DJ [SENSITIVE] as part of a collaboration with [NOT RELEASABLE].

data.short_description: UNIT-5000 - is a top-down action rogue-lite shooter where you are a mechbot operator against endless hordes of outer-world invader armies and hard bosses. Destroy everything! With the spoils of every match, unlock and upgrade new weapons to improve your mechbot and make it deadlier.
